## Description

Consult flow on the phone: ask-first consent script (agree / decline to manual note), recording with a visible indicator and background audio, chunk upload with retry and an encrypted offline queue, draft note with per-field accept, sign with biometrics. AI output stays a draft until the licensed doctor accepts each field and signs. Prescribing stays on the web app at launch (the design says so).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] **AC1.** Given the doctor declines recording, when the patient says no, then the app opens the manual note and records nothing.
- [ ] **AC2.** Given the network drops mid-recording, when it returns, then queued chunks upload in order and none is lost or duplicated.
- [ ] **AC3.** Given an AI draft field, when the doctor has not accepted it, then the note cannot be signed.
- [ ] **AC4.** Given the phone is lost, when the queue held audio, then it is encrypted and removed on remote revoke.
- [ ] **AC5.** Given unsent audio was wiped by a revoke, when the visit is opened on the web, then it is flagged 'recording incomplete: write the note by hand' (ADR-011 §4).

## Definition of Done
